title: PREVENTion of Clot in Orthopaedic Trauma

sections.abstract:
The purpose of this study is to compare aspirin versus low-molecular weight heparin (LMWH) (Enoxaparin) as a thromboprophylaxis in patients who sustain a fracture.

Posted outcomes: Number of Participants With All-cause Mortality. timeframe=90 days. Low Molecular Weight Heparin (LMWH)-Enoxaparin=45; Acetylsalicylic Acid (ASA)-Aspirin=47
